# SiriusXM + GrowthBook
Date: 2026-10-23 | Duration: 38.38999938964844m

## Summary
Adswizz selected GrowthBook for a server-side A/B testing proof of concept focused initially on yield and ad-request demand prioritization. The open-source evaluation will run alongside enterprise due diligence, using Adswizz’s internal warehouse as the experimentation data source so data remains on its premises. The open-source deployment is intended for experimentation only; feature flags are outside the current scope. Self-hosting is likely, pending infrastructure, privacy, and security review. Future use cases may include auction mechanics, pacing, pricing, demand selection, partner integrations, and marketplace-flow experiments. Enterprise capabilities discussed included governance, UI-based test management, Bayesian and Frequentist statistics, multi-armed bandits, holdouts, cumulative measurement, SSO, role-based access, dedicated Slack support, and warehouse-cost optimization. Pricing included annual platform fees of $175,000 for self-hosted or $200,000 for cloud, plus $1,250 per user and $500 per experiment. GrowthBook will provide follow-up materials, while biweekly discussions and a next meeting targeted for the first week of November were proposed.

## Keywords
Warehouse-native experimentation, Server-side A/B testing, Self-hosted deployment, Ad marketplace optimisation, Enterprise pricing, Experiment governance
